fallback.title: Open inside Telegram
fallback.body: This page runs as a Telegram Mini App: you sign in with your Telegram account and link a phone with one tap.

boot.failed: Could not sign in through Telegram. Close and reopen the app.

home.wagonHint: Last station by number, the first search is free
home.urgentHint: Locomotive, repair or crane: a request to providers in your region

phone.title: Confirm your phone
phone.body: Orders and urgent requests need a phone. Share your contact and the number is linked automatically.
phone.waiting: The bot is receiving your contact
phone.timeout: The number has not arrived yet. Check that the contact was sent to the bot and try again.
phone.declined: Contact not shared. Without a phone you can only browse.
phone.unsupported: Your Telegram is outdated. Open the bot and send the contact there.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Nothing found. Try another word or region.

wagon.title: Where is the wagon
wagon.lead: Enter the number: last station, state and the time the data refers to.
wagon.label: Wagon number
wagon.hint: 7 or 8 digits. The first search is free. Reopening a wagon you searched yourself within 6 hours is free too.
wagon.subscribe: Your free search is used up. Unlimited searches need a subscription.
wagon.guest: The session ended. Sign in again to search.
wagon.notFound: Wagon {no} was not found. Check the number and try again.

errors.WAGON_NO_INVALID: The number must have 7 or 8 digits.
errors.WAGON_NOT_CONFIGURED: Wagon search is not working yet. It will be available soon.
errors.WAGON_UPSTREAM: The search did not go through. Try again in a little while.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. You can continue in an hour.

terminal.noTariffs: No tariff published, price on request.
terminal.noSlots: No open spots today. You can see other days in the booking step.
terminal.unverified: Details not confirmed by the terminal's owner
terminal.capacity: fits {count, plural, one {# wagon} other {# wagons}}
terminal.loads: loads {count, plural, one {# wagon} other {# wagons}}
terminal.unloads: unloads {count, plural, one {# wagon} other {# wagons}}
terminal.sameStation: {count, plural, one {# more terminal} other {# more terminals}} at this station
terminal.claimBody: If you own it, you send the claim on the website: choose your organization and an operator checks it. The app stays open, the website opens in the browser.

book.title: Book a spot
book.orgAuto: An organization is created automatically with your first order. The tax ID is asked later, when documents are issued.
book.noOffer: This terminal has no tariff for this operation. Choose another operation or terminal.
book.slaNote: The terminal confirms within 30 minutes. Otherwise the spot is released automatically.

err.SLOT_FULL: No room left in this window. Choose another.
err.DEMO_TARGET: This is a sample terminal, so a place cannot be booked here.
err.HOLD_EXPIRED: The hold expired. Choose the window again.
err.HOLD_ALREADY_USED: An order already exists for this spot.
err.HOLD_NOT_EXTENDABLE: The hold can be extended only once.
err.NOT_SHIPPER: You cannot order on behalf of this organization.
err.NO_TARIFF_FOR_OPERATION: The terminal has no tariff for this operation.
err.OPERATION_NOT_OFFERED: The terminal does not perform this operation.
err.TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE: The terminal is not accepting orders right now.
err.wagonNumbers: A wagon number must be 8 digits: {list}

detail.noDocs: No documents yet: the act and invoice appear after the order is completed.
detail.noDocsDone: No act or invoice was issued for this order.
detail.docHint: The document opens in the browser; the link is valid for 10 minutes.
detail.cancelNote: Cancellation is unavailable less than 12 hours before the spot starts.
detail.closeLead: The terminal has not closed this order for {days} days. If the work is done, you can close it yourself and leave a review.
detail.closeConfirm: The order will be marked as completed and cannot be reopened. No act or invoice will be issued. Close it?
detail.closeLater: If nothing happens on the order before then, from {date} you can close it yourself and leave a review.
detail.closeFailed: Could not close the order. Please try again.
detail.closeChanged: The order changed in the meantime. The page has been updated.

hint.PENDING: Waiting for the terminal to confirm. Otherwise the spot is released automatically.
hint.CONFIRMED: The spot is reserved for you. Arrive at the scheduled time.
hint.IN_PROGRESS: Work is in progress at the terminal.
hint.REJECTED: The terminal declined. Choose another terminal or time.
hint.EXPIRED: The terminal did not respond in time, the spot was released.

reason.IDLE_CLOSED: Closed by the customer after {days} days without activity
reason.SLA_TIMEOUT: The terminal did not respond in time
reason.NO_SHOW: The customer did not arrive at the scheduled time

err.CANCEL_TOO_LATE: Less than 12 hours before the spot, cancellation is unavailable. Contact the terminal.

listing.loginNote: Everyone sees the price. The phone number opens with a subscription, and messages go through your Telegram account.

urgent.title: Urgent request
urgent.lead: Type, region and phone. Nearby providers offer a price and time.
urgent.phoneFirst: A phone is required for a request.
urgent.noOrg: Requests go to provider organizations: locomotive services, equipment owners and carriers. Add your organization on the website and requests from your region will appear here.
urgent.noOrgCta: Add an organization on the website

listings.title: My listings
listings.empty: No listings yet. List a truck in a minute.
listings.truckHint: Personally, with a phone, in a minute
listings.railHint: Locomotives and wagons are listed by an organization on the platform

form.title: Title
form.titlePh: For example: MAN TGS 20 t, curtainsider
form.serviceRegionsHint: The home region is included automatically

done.PENDING_REVIEW: The listing was sent for review.

err.LISTING_INVALID: The form is incomplete: fix the marked fields.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.loggedOut: Signed out. Next time you open the app you sign in through Telegram.
profile.subscription: Subscription: phone numbers and wagon search
profile.siteHint: Opens the website in your browser

state.title: The page did not open
state.body: The connection to the internet or the server may have dropped. Please try again.
state.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Find what you need with search.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Your orders, urgent requests and listings will appear here.
